function.name: agent_health
function.description: Check whether the local WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy agent service is reachable, whether the gateway password is accepted, and whether the agent is signed in to an account. Call this first when an agent run produces no output.

function.name: agent_info
function.description: Return environment information about the agent host: product version, OS, architecture, current working directory and uptime.

function.name: agent_run
function.description: Run a prompt on the local coding agent and return its answer. By default this waits for the run to finish (up to `timeoutSeconds`) and returns the final text. Set wait=false to get a job id back immediately and poll it with agent_job_status.

cwd.description: Working directory for the run. Defaults to the agent process CWD.

agent.description: Agent mode to use, e.g. "cli" (default), "ptc", "minimal", or a custom agent name.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for the run, e.g. "default", "plan", "acceptEdits", "delegate".

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait when wait=true. Default 300, maximum 1800.

function.name: agent_job_status
function.description: Get the current status of an agent job by id, including its lifecycle state (working / blocked / done / failed / stopped) and the transcript collected so far.

jobId.description: Job id (stable id, short id, or session id).

includeTranscript.description: Include the replayed transcript. Default true.

function.name: agent_job_reply
function.description: Send a follow-up message to an agent job that is waiting for input.

function.name: agent_jobs_list
function.description: List background agent jobs known to the local service.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

function.name: agent_workers_list
function.description: List running agent worker processes (interactive sessions, background jobs and daemons) together with the endpoint each one is serving.

function.name: agent_worker_logs
function.description: Read logs for a worker process. type may be telemetry, process, debug or transcript; tail limits the number of lines returned.

type.description: Log source: telemetry | process | debug | transcript.

tail.description: Return only the last N lines.

function.name: agent_dispatch_context
function.description: Return the context used when dispatching new agent work: default working directory, available agent modes and the default permission mode.
